report:
1. Erosion has carved nearly 300 natural rock arches in Tassili n'Ajjer, and the plateau is home to a population of Saharan cheetahs. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tassili_n%27Ajjer)
2. MenAfriVac costs less than US$0.50 per dose. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meningitis_belt)
3. Algeria's 2025 GDP at purchasing power parity is estimated at roughly US$875 billion. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
4. Frontier's total cabling runs 245 km. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
5. Algeria's 2008 census recorded a population of about 34.1 million. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Algerian_provinces_by_population)
6. Noor II was commissioned in January 2017. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ouarzazate_Solar_Power_Station)
7. The African meningitis belt is home to more than 400 million people. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meningitis_belt)
8. MenAfriVac was introduced across the meningitis belt in 2010 and has since been given to more than 350 million people. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meningitis_belt)
9. Algeria became a member of OPEC in 1969. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
10. Algeria's unemployment rate was below 9% in 2024. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
11. The GERD's expected capacity factor is below 30%. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
12. Noor II has seven hours of storage capacity and was inaugurated by King Mohammed VI. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ouarzazate_Solar_Power_Station)
13. With an installed capacity of 6.15 gigawatts, the GERD is the largest hydroelectric power plant in Africa. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
14. Frontier achieved an Rmax of more than 1 exaFLOPS. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
15. Algeria won its first Africa Cup of Nations title in 1986. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019_Africa_Cup_of_Nations_final)
16. The highest point of Tassili n'Ajjer is Adrar Afao, at 2,158 m. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tassili_n%27Ajjer)
17. Frontier is hosted at Oak Ridge in Tennessee and runs entirely on renewable electricity. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontier_(supercomputer))
18. Noor III uses a 250-metre solar tower with seven hours of energy storage. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ouarzazate_Solar_Power_Station)
19. Around 1,000 workers were employed to build the Ouarzazate solar complex. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ouarzazate_Solar_Power_Station)
20. The GERD first produced electricity on 20 February 2022, delivering 375 MW to the grid. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
